statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-107161 affects the DIGEST-MD5 plugin's add_to_challenge() function. This image installs only the Cyrus SASL core library and Berkeley DB plugin; it does not install the libsasl2-modules package containing the vulnerable libdigestmd5 plugin. See https://access.redhat.com/security/cve/CVE-2026-107161.
